title: Via Princessa:
headline: Marie came to America as a little girl with her single mom. Thrifting was how they got by. Now her thrift shop just grew into a 2,000 square foot boutique, and it is in What She's Made Of on Nov 5.
story: Rebecca's direction: I want to lean into her background and reason for starting her business, make sure we mention her expansion.

So the spine is her story: an immigrant family from Latvia, no money for the mall, thrifting as a way of life, then giving those finds back to Buffalo. The expansion opened the day this was filmed. That is the payoff.
do: Open on Marie with the hook text on frame 1.
Keep her background in her own words: Latvia, her mom, thrifting.
Say the expansion clearly: day 1, 2,000 square feet.
Hold shots 2 to 3 seconds; this client likes slow pacing.
Match the Ms Eye Candy cut: ombre open and close, captions, end card with voice-over.
dont: No logo, wordmark, name or store card at 0:00.
Do not use the host's false starts in IMG_1960 (before 00:40).
